title: R1-s entity safety (4): ceil(target_players / 2) team_CTF_redplayer and team_CTF_blueplayer team-begin spots in each base of every Quake 3 CTF map
cause: A Quake 3 client that enters a CTF game or joins a team is in TEAM_BEGIN (code/game/g_client.c:1013; code/game/g_cmds.c:599-600), and ClientSpawn takes its spot from SelectCTFSpawnPoint (code/game/g_client.c:1076-1081): SelectRandomTeamSpawnPoint searches team_CTF_redplayer or team_CTF_blueplayer, keeps the spots SpotWouldTelefrag finds free and, when none is free, returns the class's first spot anyway (code/game/g_team.c:983-1024); ClientSpawn then G_KillBox-es whoever stands there (code/game/g_client.c:1205; code/game/g_utils.c:525-545). Generated CTF maps had one begin spot per team, so when a match starts the second player of each team telefrags the first.
hypothesis: With ceil(target_players / 2) begin spots per team, each at least 64 units on x or y from every other entity, every player of a full team finds a free begin spot at a match start, so no begin telefrag occurs; nothing else in the map changes. A full team is ceil(target_players / 2) players under automatic team assignment (PickTeam joins the smaller team, code/game/g_client.c:566-583); players who pick a team by hand can stack one team beyond that unless g_teamForceBalance is set (code/game/g_cmds.c:547-560), and the extra players then get the class's first spot back, as before.
expected_mechanism: src/entities.cpp add_quake3_ctf_team_begin_spots (public; include/qmg/entities.hpp, with quake3_ctf_team_begin_spots_per_team = ceil(max(target_players, 2) / 2)) appends PlacementRole::team_initial_spawn placements (existing role; classnames team_CTF_redplayer / team_CTF_blueplayer from data/profiles/q3/generator-current.json, now cited to code/game/g_team.c:990-994 and code/game/g_spawn.c:256-257), red first, after every other placement, when the switch is on and the layout is Quake 3 CTF: in the room that holds the team's flag (joined rooms of the team's half only when the base is full), at the supported, clear, lit start_stations() nearest the team's existing begin spot, facing the base centre. The validator's ctf_spawn_contract counts the spots per team when the switch is on. The team_CTF_*spawn respawn spots, the deathmatch fallback spots and every other placement stay as they were.

That every player of a full team now finds a free begin spot is static analysis of the id code (SelectRandomTeamSpawnPoint, SpotWouldTelefrag, PickTeam); no engine was run, so the plan's engine-runtime row (0 telefrags at team begin with bots to capacity, H2) is not claimed.
failures_and_counterexamples_kept: q3-ctf-x-mech-teleporter-2: G11 already failed in the reference (flag placement 17 is unbound: navigation.player unbound_placement, and every spawn gets quality unreachable_timing_target for it); the 4 new begin spots add 4 more of the same quality error (10 -> 14), G11 status unchanged (fail). The defect is the flag's, not the new spots' (every new spot binds to a navigation node)

the new spots are active team spawns, so the visibility spawn-safety warnings (hostile_line_of_sight +146, no_cover_opportunity +51, wide_crossfire +13) and the quality timing warnings (timing_too_late +247, timing_too_early +5, unreachable_timing_target warning +12) grow with them over the 25 cases; no visibility or lighting error is added
run.py G7 counts team_CTF_redplayer/blueplayer >= 1, so it passed before and after (25/25); the strict ceil(player_max / 2) contract (R1-g) is measured here by check_compiled.py, not yet by G7
the deathmatch fallback spots (info_player_deathmatch, one in each base) are left as they are; Quake 3 CTF reads them only when a team has no team spot at all (code/game/g_team.c:1038-1040)

flip counterexample (change r1s-q3-ctf-team-begin-flip): with the switch on, qmg_tests' dense_spawn_allocation fixture (Quake 3 CTF, 2 rooms, 32 players, 'vertical dense arena') fails closed on seeds 10 and 12 of 16: add_quake3_ctf_team_begin_spots throws 'the blue base and the rooms of its half joined to it have fewer than 16 supported, clear stations' (each 2-room base already holds 16 respawn spots, the flag, items and a deathmatch spot; a 2-room map has no other room in the team's half). The uncaught exception stopped qmg_tests without output until its 1200 s timeout. Envelope over 'vertical dense arena', 3 room counts x 7 player counts x 16 seeds: only 2 rooms x 32 players fails (2/16); 'capture the flag map' at 2 rooms x 32 players: 2/16 (seeds 10, 12); 'flat open capture the flag arena': 0/16. Evidence: out/phase2/changes/r1s-q3-ctf-team-begin-flip/ctest/ctest-1.log, out/phase2/changes/r1s-q3-ctf-team-begin-flip/logs/qmg_tests-standalone-1.log, out/phase2/changes/r1s-q3-ctf-team-begin-flip/evidence/

verdict_note: Accepted on every declared fixed set (25/25 in scope, 0 out of scope, compiled lumps 25/25, G1-G8 no regression). The default flip failed on a counterexample outside the fixed sets (see failures_and_counterexamples_kept), so the switch stays off: flipping would turn 2 of 16 passing dense 2-room, 32-player generations into errors. A revised variant (more station capacity in a crowded base, or a documented fallback) needs its own experiment record before a flip.
